verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-schedule docs let you pick, per connection, one of three schedule types: Scheduled, Cron (runs on a user-defined cron expression) and Manual. The pricing page lists '15-minute syncs', which supports sub-hour frequency. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of sub-hour interval options and any plan restrictions on them (only a pricing-page bullet), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling behavior.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I control sync frequency per pipeline — from sub-hour schedules to cron expressions and manual triggers

citations.quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run. The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual
Runs the syncs based on the user-defined cron expression
If you prefer more precision in scheduling your sync, you can also use CRON scheduling to set a specific time of day or month.
